premise: At night Owl is glum because everyone plays in the daytime; Raccoon and Firefly are awake too, and Raccoon knows the best game: peekaboo, with Firefly's glow to find him.
inspiration: The lonely night-watcher of folk lullabies, turned playful: the night has its own friends, and they find each other.
lesson: Everyone has friends somewhere; sometimes you just meet them later.

en-US.title: Raccoon Cheers Up Owl
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.7 60s} [softly] The moon was high, and {all:face sleeping} the whole forest was asleep… except {owl:enter} Owl. He flew down onto a branch, {owl:face sad} all alone. {owl:live} He blinked, looked around, yawned… and dozed. One eye opened. Then two. Hoo. [sad] There's nobody to play with, he sighed. {sfx:rustle} Then, down in the grass, came a rustle, and out walked {raccoon:enter} Raccoon. {raccoon:face happy} [whispers] Psst! I'm awake! And so was {firefly:enter} Firefly, blinking her way in. {firefly:face happy} Me too! [excited] Let's play peekaboo! {raccoon:live hold} Raccoon rubbed his paws and hid his eyes. {owl:face surprised} Where's Raccoon? {firefly:live} Firefly glowed brighter and brighter, like a little lantern… blink, blink! {owl:face happy} There he is! {raccoon:live resume} Raccoon peeked through his paws and… BOO! Owl {owl:wobble} laughed a big hooting laugh. {sfx:hoot} Hoo-hoo-hoo! [happily] And every night after that, {owl:hearts} Owl, {raccoon:hearts} Raccoon and {firefly:hearts} Firefly played peekaboo under the moon.

es-ES.title: Mapache anima a Búho
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.7 60s} [softly] La luna estaba alta y {all:face sleeping} todo el bosque dormía… menos {owl:enter} Búho. Bajó volando a una rama, {owl:face sad} solito. {owl:live} Parpadeó, miró alrededor, bostezó… y se quedó traspuesto. Abrió un ojo. Luego los dos. Uh. [sad] No hay nadie con quien jugar, suspiró. {sfx:rustle} Entonces, abajo en la hierba, algo crujió, y salió andando {raccoon:enter} Mapache. {raccoon:face happy} [whispers] ¡Psst! ¡Yo estoy despierto! Y también {firefly:enter} Luciérnaga, que llegó parpadeando. {firefly:face happy} ¡Y yo! [excited] ¡Juguemos al cucú-tras! {raccoon:live hold} Mapache se frotó las patitas y se tapó los ojos. {owl:face surprised} ¿Dónde está Mapache? {firefly:live} Luciérnaga brilló más y más, como un farolillo… ¡blinc, blinc! {owl:face happy} ¡Ahí está! {raccoon:live resume} Mapache asomó entre las patitas y… ¡CUCÚ! Búho {owl:wobble} soltó una gran carcajada de búho. {sfx:hoot} ¡Uh-uh-uh! [happily] Y desde entonces, cada noche, {owl:hearts} Búho, {raccoon:hearts} Mapache y {firefly:hearts} Luciérnaga juegan al cucú-tras bajo la luna.

rustle.prompt: a small animal rustling in leaves at night, soft and curious

hoot.prompt: a cheerful owl hooting three quick soft notes, like a laugh
